rules.retrieved_snippet: Search summary (not fetched): Ley 8968 published in La Gaceta No. 170 of 5 September 2011; art. 1 protects fundamental rights incl. informational self-determination; Decreto 37554-JP regulates it and the Agencia de Protección de Datos de los Habitantes (PRODHAB) was created under its Transitorio III. A 2020 bill (No. 21.828) to restructure PRODHAB had unknown status.
